title: Can humans beat AI? Week one results
author: Mr_Hodlerr
selftext:
**Week one:** copying OKX's top 10 traders leads AI by $373. Copying Binance's top 10 lost 22%. [Track the battle live everyday.](https://botsfolio.com/battle/copy-trading-vs-ai)

Can the best human traders beat an AI? On Nov 2 I started a live test: copy the top 10 traders on Binance, OKX and Hyperliquid and run my AI next to them.

**The setup**

* $50,000 each, from the Nov 2 close.
* Three copiers: the top 10 traders by 30-day return on Binance, OKX and Hyperliquid, with $5,000 on each trader. Picked from the leaderboards on Nov 2, and picked again every 30 days.
* My AI, twice: one portfolio on bitcoin and ether, one on five altcoins. Paper money on live prices, shown after my own fee.
* Holding half BTC and half ETH as the benchmark.
* The copier numbers come from each trader's own account, day by day, after a 10% profit share. That is the best case for a copier.

**Standings after one week**

|Player|Value|Return|Worst drop|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|Copying OKX's top 10|$50,050|\+0.10%|6.7%|
|Botsfolio AI: bitcoin and ether|$49,677|\-0.65%|1.2%|
|Copying Hyperliquid's top 10|$49,382|\-1.24%|5.7%|
|Botsfolio AI: altcoins|$49,276|\-1.45%|2.7%|
|Holding BTC and ETH|$48,195|\-3.61%|9.7%|
|Copying Binance's top 10|$38,893|\-22.21%|29.6%|

**What happened**

* **Binance.** The ten traders at the top of the leaderboard were showing 30-day returns between 2,000% and 5,700%. One week later, one of them is at -100% and another at -98%. Two more are down 49% and 74%. One doubled.
* **OKX.** The copier was up $3,600 on Nov 8 and gave almost all of it back the next day. Seven of its ten traders are up. Three are down 36% to 45%.
* **Hyperliquid.** Six of ten vaults are up. Two are down 20% and 32%.
* **Botsfolio AI.** On bitcoin and ether it lost $323 while holding lost $1,805, and it never fell more than 1.2%.

So after week one the humans are ahead, by $373, and it took a 6.7% drop to get there. Returns like the ones on those leaderboards come from leverage. My AI trades spot only.

It's one week and it proves nothing yet. The copiers pick new traders on Dec 2 and I'll post the standings as it goes.

**Your call:** who is ahead on Dec 2, the humans or the AI? And if you copy traders, how do you pick them?

comments.author: Dependent-Ocelot908
comments.body: Binance just shows 5000% profit on its leaderboard to entice users and take their money from them. Its a revenue bait.

replies.author: Mr_Hodlerr
replies.body: Will know after few months where this live battle goes. But yes, 5000% in 30 days is luck and can't be consistent, risk like that ends up blowing up your account at some point.

comments.author: alittlebitnostalgic
comments.body: Real test will be how  they perform when the market moves against them. Making money in a good week is one thing, but handling losses without blowing up is a different story.

replies.author: Mr_Hodlerr
replies.body: Market has been tough, Binance top 10 were in lead and now at the bottom. Lets see as time goes by after few months what we have, they might comeback

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the Binance row is what ranking by 30-day return does. a month like those is mostly oversized bets that haven't been caught yet, so the board hands you whoever is standing closest to the edge. rank the same traders by their worst drop over a year and you'd be copying ten different people.

replies.author: Dependent-Ocelot908
replies.body: For cex, its difficult to get historical data and you only see the leaders. But for hyperliquid it can be done, so you mean add a player were money is split in 10 traders on hyperliquid who are ranked by worst drop (least drop being rank 1)? Nice idea, if I am missing something let me know.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: yes, that's it. one catch: set a minimum history and trade count first, or a wallet opened last week with zero drop ranks number one. hyperliquid gives you the full record so you can do it properly there.
